title: ClimateState
description: Climate as known by the engine. The only actuator is the ESP32 fan. In auto mode the engine raises fan speed while temperature_c is above target_c plus the hysteresis from Settings and lowers it below target_c minus the hysteresis.

temperature_c.description: Latest air temperature, degrees Celsius, one decimal place, null when unknown.

humidity_pct.description: Latest relative humidity, percent, integer 0 to 100, null when unknown.

target_c.description: Target temperature, degrees Celsius, one decimal place, 16.0 to 30.0.

fan_confirmed.description: True when the device acknowledged fan_speed.

updated_at.description: Last change of any field, ISO 8601 UTC.
